ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Power, CardRarity.Uncommon, TargetType.Self)` (Rupture.cs:18-21) == cost 1 / POWER / UNCOMMON / SELF.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new PowerVar<StrengthPower>(1m)` (Rupture.cs:14) == `_strength = 1`. Note the var is keyed on StrengthPower but is the amount handed to RUPTUREPower (Rupture.cs:25), the same key/target mismatch as card/demon_form and card/feeding_frenzy -- checked rather than assumed.

OnPlay.rationale: `PowerCmd.Apply<RupturePower>(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, DynamicVars.Strength.BaseValue, Owner.Creature, this)` (Rupture.cs:25) == `PowerCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, RupturePower, self._strength, applier=ctx.player)` -- correctly `PowerCmd.apply` and not `StrengthCmd.apply`, since RupturePower is not Strength. No animation on either side. THIS CARD IS THE WITNESS FOR TWO OTHER FINDINGS: RupturePower's implementation (powers.py:436-495 currently -- moved since audit, re-verified: still gains Strength on damage its owner receives while it is the owner's own turn, deferred per-card via `before_card_played`/`on_card_played` accumulation) is what makes card/breakthrough's hand-rolled HP loss and seam gap G6 (lose_max_hp not routing through the damage pipeline, via card/brightest_flame) both LIVE. NOTE: the power's own verdict belongs to the power stream, not this record; flagged here only as supporting evidence for Rupture's OnPlay.
